free_tier.stated: Not stated numerically. 'Will you keep my files forever? Yes'. No published storage ceiling found; account creation is unverified and email-less.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: 500 MB per file; 50 MB per URL upload
per_object_cap.notes: the beta REST API has a separate 100 MB per-upload cap

retention.stated: Yes, we also offer a temporary uploads feature which will automatically delete your files after a certain period of time.
retention.notes: the FAQ offers temporary uploads that are deleted after a period it does not quantify; no numeric expiry is published on the pages read

egress.terms: No stated cap; files served directly.

tooling: the FAQ documents a beta REST API with a personal token header, node discovery, multipart upload and uploaded-file listing; web upload is also available
chaining: Unlimited email-less accounts x no stated quota x permanent retention. The classic anonfiles shape. The practical limit is extension whitelisting, which forbids arbitrary binary blobs.
limits_note: Strict extension allowlist: only video/audio/image/archive/doc extensions (.mp4 .mkv .mp3 .flac .png .pdf .zip .7z .tar .iso .torrent .kdbx ..). No .bin/.parquet/.npy. This kills it as a raw dataset store. CSAM scanning via Cloudflare tooling purges the entire account on any hit.

identity_cost.detail: registration asks for a username and a password of 6-72 characters, explicitly does not use email, and is open

reliability_note: Retention claims 'forever' and has been stable for years, but the extension allowlist and account-wide purge on a single CSAM hash match are real technical failure modes. Domain has rotated (.me -> .cr) more than once.
